predicates.rule: The pre-state depositCount is strictly less than maxLifetimeDeposits; capacity exhaustion rejects deposits but does not disable withdrawals.
The prover knows ownerSecret and rho; owner and note commitments recompute for this pool, note index, and ticket.
The old note leaf at pre-state depositCount is empty and exactly one canonical append yields the new note root.
Counters, roots, sequence, state bytes, and state UTXO value change exactly as the DEPOSIT transition specifies.
externalFundingInput = 10000000 + transparentChange + fee; state value increases 10000000; carriers preserve value.
No PAYOUT role exists; zero or one fixed-position transparent change output may exist.
The private note recomputes and is a canonical member of the old note root at its private index.
The prover knows the owner secret committed by the note and derives the public nullifier from the same secret, pool, index, and rho.
The public nullifier is absent in the old set and exactly one authenticated insertion yields the new nullifier root.
Counters, roots, sequence, state bytes, and state UTXO value change exactly as the WITHDRAWAL transition specifies.
Exactly one fixed-position token-free payout sends 10000000 sats to the public statement locking bytecode.
externalFeeInput = transparentChange + fee; state releases exactly the payout ticket; carriers preserve value; pool subsidy is zero.

inputs: index N+1: exactly one DEPOSIT_FUNDING or FEE_FUNDING signed external input
transactionShape.rule: N is at least one. No other input or output count, role, index, or ordering is valid. The optional change presence is itself context-bound.

carrierLifecycle.rule: Every carrier input is a persistent role UTXO created at pool genesis and recreated atomically by every action.
requirements: the consumed state outpoint has output index zero; carrier ordinal i has source output index i+1 and exactly the same source transaction ID as the state outpoint
the current action recreates state at output zero and carrier ordinals 0..N-1 at outputs 1..N, making one atomic predecessor/successor lineage bundle
the carrier manifest commits normalized role templates, values, token records, ordinals, and the proof-section schedule, never concrete locks containing the manifest digest
source and successor locks are exact downstream instantiations of the committed templates and preserve identical bytes
source and successor satoshi values are equal
token data is exactly preserved or exactly absent as specified by the manifest
each carrier verifies the same statement digest, proof security profile, proof-session header, and its unique non-overlapping proof section
all sections are required exactly once
cross-spliced, omitted, duplicated, reordered, foreign, or accepting-filler roles fail
no carrier stock, replenisher, coordinator, or action-specific setup transaction exists

transactionBinding.projectionConsistencyRule: Every field represented both directly in PoolActionFv1Statement and inside TxContextFv1 must be byte-for-byte equal, including pool/action/security/manifest IDs, state outpoint/value/lock/token/state bytes, payout, fee, and role indices. Every verifier carrier absorbs one byte-identical statement encoding and one transactionContextDigest; no independently supplied duplicate is authoritative.
transactionBinding.circularityRule: Excluded data may not affect state, payout, fee, role ordering, source identity, outputs, or proof validity. Each input script must canonically parse and validate its own excluded unlocking data. The external signature uses a whole-transaction output-binding signature mode.

rules: exactly one token-free external signed input is the final input
zero or one token-free transparent change output is the final output
fee is nonnegative, context-derived, and no greater than immutable maxFeeSats
state and carrier values cannot subsidize the fee
the external input owner authorizes the final transaction outputs
the funding signature hash type is exactly BCH SIGHASH_ALL|FORKID 0x41; ANYONECANPAY, NONE, and SINGLE are forbidden
fee source, change, amount, roles, and ordering are public and context-bound

reconstructionAndRace.authoritativeState: The unique unspent state NFT reachable from the downstream recorded genesis state outpoint through valid PoolActionFv1 successors; that outpoint is not an input to poolInstanceId.
reconstructionAndRace.raceRule: At most one transaction spending a state tip can succeed. A losing wallet discards the stale proof and signatures, reconstructs the winning successor and witnesses, rebuilds the full context, re-proves, re-signs, and retries.
reconstructionAndRace.reorgRule: Wallets retain enough note-secret and chain-checkpoint material to replay from a known ancestor. Reorged, evicted, or conflicted actions return to reconstruction; local journals are not consensus authority.
reconstructionAndRace.broadcastBoundary: Successful zero-confirmation node/mempool acceptance is an operational submission result, while reorg and conflict monitoring remain explicit wallet states.

implementationGates: A concrete PoolConfigFv1 instance exists and contains no runtime selector or privileged path.
The identity derivation DAG is acyclic: normalized templates precede poolInstanceId and carrierManifestDigest; concrete locks and genesis outpoints are downstream records.
Every state/carrier input bundle is derived from outputs zero through N of one predecessor transaction and every action recreates that bundle exactly.
Every responsibility has an enforcer and at least one single-invariant mutation.
An exact empty-shell deposit and withdrawal transaction establish byte and carrier-lifecycle lower bounds.
The selected nullifier set proves non-membership and insertion, not membership alone.
The selected transaction-context digest is implementable from current BCH introspection without proof/signature circularity.
A concrete 128-bit soundness worksheet and ZK leakage review pass before full AIR/prover construction.
